The Future of PMM

Executive Summary — Pilot Program Results & H2 Engagement Plan

Prepared for Brenda Brown · September 2026 · Chris O'Hara

🎯 1. The Vision: Three Pillars of PMM Excellence

The Book of Work establishes product marketing as a strategic discipline at SAP. To bring it to life across ~500 PMMs, we've defined three pillars — each AI-enabled:

Pillar 01
Disciplined Operations
Execute with consistency — one set of playbooks, frameworks, and standards every PMM inherits on day one.
Pillar 02
Connected Community
One culture, shared success — all-hands, AMAs, spotlights, and recognition that makes best practices travel faster.
Pillar 03
Continuous Learning
Real-time sandbox and Labs — hands-on sessions where PMMs apply AI tools to real work.
This Report: The Future of PMM pilot represents the first Labs cohort under Pillar 03 — validating the learning journey and AI Labs before scaling to all 500 PMMs.

What Learners Said

"I need to change my overall mindset of how to use AI from intern to co-worker."

"How AI should be used to optimize workflows throughout the funnel and how PMMs need to fundamentally rethink their roles."

"Understanding GEO — SEO does not ensure returns in AI results."

"How to structure PMM content so AI agents can parse it, quote it, and cite it accurately."

Key Finding: The curriculum successfully shifted mental models. Learners consistently cited the "AI as co-worker" framework as an actionable insight they're applying to their work.

🔬 4. AI in Action: PMM Labs

A safe sandbox to test AI use cases across LoBs. Three labs are live and demonstrated in the pilot:

Lab 01
GEO Visibility Test
Score how visible your product is to AI-assisted buyer research. Get recommendations for ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.

Output: Analysis Report

Lab 02
CI Brief Generator
Input competitor intel and deal context. Get a sales-ready brief with trap questions and objection handlers.

Output: Sales Brief

Lab 03
Launch Planner
Input launch criteria. Get a complete materials list with T-minus timeline, RACI, and risk register.

Output: Launch BOM

Labs → Book of Work Areas

LabPrimary BoW AreasPMM Gets
GEO Visibility Test09 GTM & Field ReadinessVisibility score (1-10), specificity analysis, quick wins, rewrite examples
CI Brief Generator03 Market Insights, 07 CommercializationCompetitive brief, trap-setting questions, objection handlers
Launch Planner08 Launch & DisclosureLaunch BOM, T-minus timeline, RACI matrix, risk register
Vision — PMM Co-Pilot: Transform these experimental labs into production-ready AI agents operating within SAP infrastructure (Joule, SAP AI Core) with proper guardrails. The Book of Work becomes an interactive system — AI agents that help PMMs execute each area while maintaining quality and strategic alignment.

📅 5. H2 Engagement Plan: From Vision to 500 PMMs

Move the whole org from aware to active to contributing over the second half — each phase makes the next one land.

REACH
Everyone hears it
Quarterly all-hands, exec comms from Eric & Brenda, community hub as front door
ACTIVATE
Many take part
Learning journey + Labs, monthly AMAs & Spotlight Series, first playbooks in hand
EMBED
It becomes the norm
Playbooks used in daily work, champions network in every LoB, recognition & measured adoption
Measured the Whole Way: % of the 500 reached → % activated → % contributing — reported back each quarter.

🚀 6. Next Steps

Immediate: Site Migration

A complete Migration Guide has been prepared documenting current architecture, database schema, SAP BTP equivalents, and phase-by-phase migration plan. Ready to hand off to IT.

In Progress: SuccessFactors Learning

The 12-unit curriculum is being adapted for SuccessFactors Learning — formal completion tracking, integration with employee learning records, scalable delivery to all SAP PMMs globally.

Phase 03 Vision: Embed

As the organization moves to Phase 03, the ultimate vision:

  1. Learning — PMMs complete the curriculum to build foundational AI-era skills
  2. Tools — AI agents assist with each of the 19 Book of Work areas
  3. Guardrails — All AI-assisted work operates within approved guidelines and audit trails
  4. Measurement — Track engagement and contribution across the 500 PMMs

✅ Summary

The Future of PMM pilot achieved its objectives under Pillar 03: Continuous Learning:

  • Validated demand — 181 users registered, 53 provided feedback, NPS of 9.1
  • Proved the curriculum — 73% pass rate, strong qualitative feedback on learning outcomes
  • Demonstrated lab potential — Three live labs showed what PMM co-pilots could enable
  • Prepared for scale — Migration guide complete, SuccessFactors integration in progress

The pilot positions the organization to move from ACTIVATE (first Labs cohort) to EMBED (playbooks adopted cross-LoB, recognition program live, engagement measured) across all 500 PMMs.

Thank you for your support of this initiative.
